span.p:
Sample N=16 circuits
per molecule via
autoregressive decoder

div.style: color: rgb(55, 48, 163) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evaluate Energies
via Cache or L-BFGS-B

div.style: color: rgb(109, 40, 217) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compute Multi-Component Reward
R = w₁·(-E/|E_ref|) + w₂·entanglement
+ w₃·(-depth/max_len) + w₄·non_commute

div.style: color: rgb(109, 40, 217) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GRPO Advantage Normalization
A_i = (R_i - mean(R)) / (std(R) + ε)

div.style: color: rgb(109, 40, 217) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DAPO Loss (Asymmetric Clipping)
L = -min(r·A, clip(r, 1-ε_low, 1+ε_high)·A)
ε_low=0.2, ε_high=0.28

div.style: color: rgb(109, 40, 217) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Policy Gradient Update
θ ← θ - η·∇L

div.style: color: rgb(6, 95, 70) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MAP-Elites Archive Update
Insert into 10×10 grid
(entanglement × depth)

div.style: color: rgb(6, 95, 70) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Replay Buffer Mixing
60% elites + 30% novelty
+ 10% random exploration
